## Houston v0.6.9

- Cloud conversations now keep their context reliably across multiple messages.
- Azure OpenAI connections now correctly use your pasted endpoint, including Foundry project links.
- Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan keys now connect through the correct regional service.
- You can now attach ZIP, TAR, GZ, TGZ, BZ2, XZ, and ZST archives in chat.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
